item.description:
Edith 1.4.1

Vertically centered line numbers

  • Fixed line number alignment in the gutter to always remain vertically centered in relation to the corresponding editor line across all line heights and spacing settings.
  • Eliminated vertical line number shifting during typing, line insertion, and line deletion.

Edith 1.4.0

Open a new document on launch setting

  • Added a new setting under General: “Open a new document on first launch” (enabled by default).
  • When enabled, launching Edith without previous session documents opens a new blank document with the cursor activated and ready for typing.
  • When disabled, Edith launches cleanly without creating an empty document window if no session documents are present.

Edith 1.3.0

Line height setting

  • Editor Defaults gains a Line Height slider (1.0× to 2.0×). The chosen spacing applies immediately to open documents, carries into new text as you type, and persists across launches.
  • Line numbers in the gutter and invisible-character markers now align to the text baseline, so they stay in step with the text at any line height.
